groups.name: wow.cocache
groups.description: wow-cocache's settings, `wow.cocache.*`: the one default of each key, and the class its configuration metadata comes from. The module imports no Spring Boot, so WowCoCacheAutoConfiguration reads its keys from Spring's `Environment`, falling back to the defaults here; the host knows the keys from the metadata this module ships. A reader's settings of each cache (its local copies, its negative caching, the lifetime of what it fills) are CoCache's own, `cocache.caches.[wow.<context>.<aggregate>].*`.

properties.name: wow.cocache.publish
properties.description: The aggregate types, `<context>.<aggregate>`, whose states this service writes into their caches after each commit; each must be one of the service's own, with a state its contract publishes. None when not set: a state no one reads pays no write.

properties.name: wow.cocache.ttl
properties.description: How long a state this service writes lives in the cache, a deleted aggregate's tombstone too: the cache's own lifetime (`cocache.caches.[wow.<context>.<aggregate>].ttl`, else CoCache's default) when not set. A reader's fill lives by the reader's lifetime, so give both sides the same.
